correction.description: Live caller-visible SMS/PDU parent EXISTS filtering; no FTS sub_id trust; per-request argument array. Proposed owned source only, not applied to an Android checkout.

source_bound_SQL_review.actual_FTS3_DDL: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE words USING FTS3 (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, index_text TEXT, source_id INTEGER, table_to_use INTEGER, sub_id INTEGER);
source_bound_SQL_review.actual_current_search_query: SELECT snippet(words, '', ' ', '', 1, 1) as snippet FROM words WHERE index_text MATCH ? AND sub_id IN (1,-1) ORDER BY snippet LIMIT 50;
source_bound_SQL_review.proposed_restricted_query: SELECT snippet(words, '', ' ', '', 1, 1) as snippet FROM words WHERE index_text MATCH ? AND ((words.table_to_use=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sms_restricted WHERE sms_restricted._id=words.source_id AND sms_restricted.sub_id IN (1,-1))) OR (words.table_to_use=2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM part INNER JOIN pdu_restricted ON part.mid=pdu_restricted._id WHERE part._id=words.source_id AND pdu_restricted.sub_id IN (1,-1)))) ORDER BY snippet LIMIT 50;
